Monday, June 6, 2022  7:00 PM  Council Chambers/Teleconference

In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361), City Council Resolution Nos. 2487, 2490, 2491, 2493, 2498,
2499, 2503 and 2505 due to the continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing directives
as a result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being broadcast via teleconference. Members of
the public may participate in-person in the Council Chambers, or virtually in the meeting in the following ways:

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1 669 900 6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
882 2803 1808 Passcode: 302365. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call in option from
a phone line.)

- Public correspondence may be emailed to the carolc@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00
p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the Planning Commission for their consideration and
included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an
“eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp
page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen
by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store), by
entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 882 2803 1808 Passcode: 302365.

- Members of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the
following process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at
the lower portion of your screen. The host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you
would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, JUNE 6, 2022

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR SCHACHTER at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes
Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274, and via teleconference pursuant to Assembly Bill 361.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  COMMISSIONER OLSON led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Schachter, Yoo, Medawar, Carman, Low, Olson, Edler

  Commissioners Absent:  None

  City Staff Present:  David Wahba, Director of Community Development & Public Works
  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Dean Flores, Associate Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, MAY 9, 2022

VICE CHAIR YOO made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER OLSON to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF MAY 9, 2022.

There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

COMMISSIONER OLSON made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR YOO to,

  APPROVE ITEM NO. 6A

There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-220132; LOCATION: 828 SILVER SPUR ROAD
  (CHASE BANK); APPLICANT: GAVIN BLODGETT; A request for a Precise Plan of Design
  (PPD-220217) to construct a new detached solar carport accessory structure on the north
  side of the parking at an existing commercial property (Chase Bank).

Dean Flores, Associate Planner provided a presentation on Planning Application No. 220132
summarizing the staff report.

Associate Planner Flores stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve
Planning Application No. PA-220132, a Precise Plan of Design (PPD-220217) to construct a
detached solar carport structure at the rear parking lot of an existing commercial property,
installation of lighting, installation of a ground-mounted transformer, and wall-mounted PV
equipment along the existing trash enclosure.

There were no members of the public present online or in person.

There was no discussion from the Planning Commissioners.

 PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
 MINUTES, JUNE 6, 2022
  1
 COMMISSIONER EDLER made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR YOO to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-220132 AS PRESENTED.

AYES: Schachter, Yoo, Medawar, Carman, Low, Olson, Edler
NOES:
ABSENT:
ABSTAIN:

Planning Manager Naughton stated that the Planning Commission approved Planning Application
No. 220132, approving a Precise Plan of Design (PPD-220217) at 828 Silver Spur Road. There
is a 20-day appeal period by where any member of the public or the City Council, by its own
motion, may appeal this project to the City Council.

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

NONE

9.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

COMMISSIONER EDLER asked about the trees along the Casaba berm. Director Wahba stated
that he has various options that he will discuss with Commissioner Edler.

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR stated that there is overgrown vegetation at 34 Santa Bella and
asked if a well check can be done at this property.

10.  MANAGER ITEMS

Planning Manager Naughton stated that today is her last day with the City of Rolling Hills Estates.
She thanked the Planning Commission for the opportunity to serve as staff liaison and serve the
community.

11.  CEREMONIAL ITEMS

A.  RECOGNITION OF PLANNING MANAGER JEANNIE NAUGHTON

Director Wahba presented Planning Manager Naughton with a Certificate in Recognition of her
service and dedication to the City of Rolling Hills Estates.

The Planning Commissioners individually thanked Planning Manager Naughton for her work,
professionalism, and dedication to the City and wished her well in her new position.

12.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, MAY 10, 2022

B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, MAY 24, 2022

VICE CHAIR YOO made a motion to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM NO. 12A – 12B

There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered

13.  ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR SCHACHTER adjourned the meeting at 7:17 p.m.

Respectfully submitted by,  Approved,

Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Robert Schachter, Chair

 PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
 MINUTES, JUNE 6, 2022
